senses.gloss:
m. (-लः)
1 Smoke.
2 A cloud.
E.
ख the sky, तमाल a tree with dark blossoms; the etherial Tamāla.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Dug, excavated.
2 Torn, rent.
n. (-तं)
1 A square or oblong pond.
2 Any excavation.
E.
खन to dig, affix क्त, and the pen. lengthened.

m. (-कः)
1 A delver, a digger.
2 A debtor; more correctly खादक
n. (-कं)
A moat, a ditch.
E.
खात a pond, affix कन्.

f. (-भूः)
A moat, a ditch.
E.
खात a pond, भू earth.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A square or large pond.
2 A spade, a hoe.
3 A wood.
4 A thread.
E.
खन to dig, ष्ट्रन् Uṇādi aff.
